items.title: Narvin Kimball Interview, 1961-11-25
items.q: And Joan Lunsford was singing with him then. And I had made the arrangement for a seven piece group. And Joe had several other compositions that he wanted to record as well. We went up in the Roosevelt Hotel on the second floor.

ctx.x: Anyway, we can check and find the other titles then.

Speaking about recordings, while I was with Celestan's band, I had composed several numbers, particularly the number, Don't Let Old Age Creep Upon You. And we were in Memphis, Tennessee, and we broadcast from the Peabody Hotel in Memphis. And the numbers were heard by some scouts. They came over to the dance that night, and they asked several times to have it played. So he played it for them. And they came down here, and they wanted to have it recorded.
